blockers.detail: D1 has no source ONNX; D2 exposes eight anonymous classes instead of the advertised six and uses IR version 10.
C1 passes static ONNX checks but its embedded Ultralytics AGPL-3.0 metadata conflicts with the model-card Apache-2.0 declaration; C2 has no source ONNX.
No 1000-record calibration manifest is frozen for the pretrained candidates.
No official Journey 6 OpenExplorer/HUCP package was discovered; RDK S100/S100P/S600 substitution is forbidden.
Board identity, SKU, march, BSP, runtime ABI, and runtime version are unavailable.
HIL contracts and ROS package build pass, but the official-runtime 30-minute loop and network fault matrix were not run.
The checksum-bound bundle is a skeleton because no releasable model, exact SDK/runtime profile, or board inventory exists.
The existing close-range V1 classifier stop condition remains in force and is not replaced by this development-only pretrained audit.
